## Claims
- [source-backed] In \(\bar\Lambda=\Lambda/I_{r,n-r}\), the classes \(\bar s_\lambda\), \(\lambda\subseteq(n-r)^r\), are an integral Schur basis, with truncated Littlewood–Richardson multiplication. [doi:10.1112/jlms.12832, lines 213-218; 263-269]
- [source-backed] For \(i=s-t+1,\ j=r-t+1,\ a=\min(n-r-i,r-j),\ b=\min(i,j)\), the lower-adjoined family \(\{\bar s_\mu:i^j\subseteq\mu\subseteq(i^j,b^a)\}\) generates \(J_v\). [doi:10.1112/jlms.12832, lines 219-235]
- [proved] For every valid \(\varphi=(n,r,i,j,a,b,N)\), every tall row \(\operatorname{Lin}_\varphi(\rho)\) is an integral combination of original wide rows, retaining all variables \(A_{\lambda,\theta}\).
- [proved] The lower-adjoined residue classes form a homogeneous integral basis:
  \[
  J_v/A_+J_v\cong
  \bigoplus_{\rho\subseteq b^a}\mathbb Z[\bar s_{(i^j,\rho)}].
  \]

## Strategy
Let \(q=n-r\), \(A=\Lambda/I_{r,q}\), and \(G_L=\{\bar s_{(i^j,\rho)}:\rho\subseteq b^a\}\). Generation gives \(\mathbb ZG_L\twoheadrightarrow Q:=J_v/A_+J_v\).

For \(a\ge1\), a homogeneous kernel relation in degree \(ij+N\), \(N>0\), has form
\[
\sum_{|\rho|=N}c_\rho\bar s_{(i^j,\rho)}
=\sum_{|\lambda|<N}f_\lambda\bar s_{(i^j,\lambda)},
\qquad \deg f_\lambda=N-|\lambda|>0.
\]
The left side is nonzero in \(A\), since its Schur classes are distinct basis elements. The source reduction converts such a relation into decomposable equations with zero wide right sides and a nonzero tall right side. [doi:10.1112/jlms.12832, lines 270-344]

The accepted task-292 repair supplies the needed integral contradiction without the false enlargement/projection step. For a tall bottom partition \(\beta\subseteq b^a\),
\[
\operatorname{CP}(\bar s_\beta\otimes1)=
\sum_{\substack{\lambda,\mu\\\mu\ne\varnothing}}
(-1)^{|\mu|+1}c_{\lambda,\mu}^{\beta}\,
\operatorname{CP}(\bar s_\lambda\otimes\bar s_{\mu'}).
\]
This follows integrally from the antipode identity
\(S(s_\mu)=(-1)^{|\mu|}s_{\mu'}\). [doi:10.1112/jlms.12832, lines 702-735]
For each nonzero summand, \(\lambda\subseteq\beta\subseteq b^a\) and
\(\mu'\subseteq\beta'\subseteq a^b\); hence it corresponds to the original wide partition
\[
(i+\mu'_1,\ldots,i+\mu'_j,\lambda_1,\ldots,\lambda_a)
\]
inside \(q^r\). The restricted tensor map
\(A_{\lambda,\theta}\mapsto\bar s_\lambda\otimes\bar s_\theta\)
is injective by the integral Schur basis, so this is an equality of original full-coordinate row vectors. Thus a nonzero tall right side cannot coexist with zero wide right sides.

For \(N=0\), and also when \(a=0\), \(G_L\) has only its lowest-degree class; \(A_+J_v\) has strictly larger degree, so that class remains nonzero in \(Q\). Therefore the displayed surjection is injective in every degree.

The requested lower-adjoined integral-basis target is established. No \(G_L\)-to-\(G_R\) transition computation is used or scheduled.
